notes_for_editor: Only one source places this tower: the tnlandforms.us Georgia lookout list, which gives a name, county, coordinates, elevation (1,405, no unit stated on the page; the story reads it as feet) and a GFC number, and its page footer is marked revised 22 March 2016. Two WebSearch queries and a firetower.org Georgia lookup found nothing about a Yorkville tower or GFC 721. The list does not say what gfc stands for, so the story does not name an agency. The brief's register reads 'GFC US 721'; the list reads 'gfc-721'. Wikipedia gives 1,362 ft (415 m) for the community area, a different point from the tower, not a conflict. No build date, design, height, status, staffing or access level appears in any source, so the story covers the list entry only. Do not add height, status or access without a new source. The brief's status and access stay unknown.
